title: Hindi
description: Hindi (second language, Group I) for ICSE Examination Years 2027 and 2028: the Class X portion of Sahitya Sagar, Naya Raasta and Ekanki Sanchay with the language paper.

syllabusBaselines.source: CISCE circular dated 20 April 2026 bifurcating the Indian language syllabuses for Examination Years 2027 and 2028 (reproduced in full; reported by The Telegraph), read with the ICSE Year 2027 regulations.
syllabusBaselines.note: Verified October 2026. The Class X examination tests only the Class X portion: Sahitya Sagar five short stories and five poems, Naya Raasta Sarg 14 to Sarg 26, and three plays from Ekanki Sanchay. Section A language is 40 marks and Section B prescribed texts 40 marks in a 3-hour 80-mark paper with 20 marks internal assessment. The circular states the split carries forward to 2028.
